result.topic_en: Euler finishes the third case of the elastic-thread equilibrium problem, noting the tension equations cannot be integrated in general. He then begins the fourth case: elastic threads that are already curved in their natural state, with osculating radius r given as a function of arc length s.

items.english: Now therefore the differential of this value would have to be set equal to the former, so that an equation between the elements of the curve is obtained; but it would be superfluous to undertake this labour here in general.
